# DIY Cold Air Intake with Snorkel

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Replace the stock air filter with a K&N performance filter, swap out the factory intake tube for a mandrel-bent one, remove the original inlet to install a larger diameter version, then construct and mount an aftermarket or custom snorkel assembly. [t997]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Replace the stock air filter with a K&N performance filter.
2. Swap out the factory intake tube connecting the air box to the engine for a mandrel-bent tube of similar interior diameter.
3. Remove the original air inlet on the air box and install a larger interior diameter inlet tube in its place.
4. Construct and mount an aftermarket or custom snorkel assembly.

_Procedure reported by [t997]._

## Parts

- K&N Air Filter [t997]
- [Partial] Larger Air Inlet Tube [t997]
- [Partial] Mandrel Bent Intake Tube [t997]

## Tips & gotchas

- Ensure all connections are made completely airtight. [t997]
- Compare power and MPG against a factory baseline before making changes. [t997]
